newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher gains after top-end profits.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher gains after top-end profits.

text.p: Kingfisher Plc shares rose in pre-market trade on Wednesday as the retailer's profits topped the range of analyst forecasts and the group said the current year had started "encouragingly."
The stock was up 9p at 683-1/2 by 0815 GMT in volume of 382,794 shares.
Pre-tax profits before exceptionals rose 36 percent to 390.2 million stg in the year to February 1, compared with forecasts mostly in a range between 376 million stg and 380.1 million.

The company said all its main businesses increased sales and improved their shares of key markets, with particularly strong growth from do-it-yourself arm B&Q, electrical retailer Comet and stores chain Woolworth.
"The results look very good with profits at the top of the range of expectations, it looks pretty good across the board," said one analyst.
Some other retail groups nudged higher on the back of the figures with electrical retailer Dixons Group Plc up 2p at 497-1/2, catalogue retailer Argos Plc up 2p at 644
